name: bitacora
description: Your journal, like a bullet journal without an app: habit trackers, notes of the day, collections and a monthly reflection. Say what you did and what happened; your agent keeps it exact. Trackers, types of note and collections are the owner's, and change over time.

stays_local: the memory file with the trackers, every day's records, the notes, the collections and the monthly reflections (the agent queries it and sees the answers)
agent_sees: the trackers, their goals and the reasons the owner gave for them
the recorded values, streaks and statistics, when it queries them
the notes' text and the collections' items, when it queries or searches them
the text of the monthly reflections
everything the owner types in the conversation
cannot_guarantee: what the agent sees leaves the computer for the AI provider, under its terms; habits like sleep can be health-related data
the memory file is not encrypted
a removed note or item stops showing but stays in the memory file, marked as voided
there are no notifications or reminders: the reflection is offered only when the owner opens a conversation
the protocol tells the agent not to give health advice, but an AI's replies can't be guaranteed; the patterns it shows are coincidences in the owner's record, not causes
